# A sandboxed tray can run without claiming a separate DBus service name

Entry 780 changes the Linux tray service from spawn to spawn_without_dbus_name. The commit explains that Flatpak’s namespace can give processes the same PID and that default generated DBus names can collide or be denied. Current code uses ksni::TrayService and runs run_without_dbus_name in a spawned thread, logging an error on failure. Keep service-name ownership separate from creating a tray service or owning its handle. The current crate API is newer than the original method, so do not copy the historical call spelling into new code. Flatpak DBus behavior and the described failure were not tested here.

Scope: linux-tray-dbus.
